ns2:section.sectionText: Most of the course will be online but will also have some hands-on sessions in person from time to time. Sedentary Behavior and Health The course will cover the key concepts related to sedentary behavior, its measurement and current evidence on the associations between sedentary behavior with health outcomes. Students will critically review current literature, discuss the impact of methodologies used to measure sedentary behavior on the reported associations with health outcomes. As hands-on experience, students will learn how to deploy accelerometers, download, quality check and reduce their own data. By comparing the results from ActiLife to a 24-h physical activity recall, they will discuss advantages and limitations of each method.
